selection: SciSpace indexes were treated as leads rather than proof of accuracy or peer review. Digoxin consensus ID 201s1dwfs4 was selected and original full text opened; other indexed leads were not automatically cited. Respiratory question surfaced conflicting historical hypercapnia explanations; current lesson uses controlled-oxygen guidance instead of a single-mechanism assertion.
accessIssues: Several PMC opens returned CAPTCHA; publisher pages and society-hosted PDFs were used instead where possible. No inaccessible full text is described as read. OSA publisher abstract/recommendation preview and pulse-oximetry abstract were read; their limitations are explicit. Fifth MI indexed JACC text was initially found, then substantive official 2026 ESC slides were opened and used instead.
dateVerification: Cystic fibrosis final publication 2015 (not PMC upload 2020). Acid-base review issue Jan2023 (copyright2022). Pulse-oximetry study March2024 issue (copyright2023). AF guideline released Nov2023, Circulation Jan2024 issue. Fifth MI Aug28 online/Sep15 2026 JACC issue, verified PubMed metadata; actual support from 2026 ESC slides.
scopeLimit: Only the 24 specified lesson objects reviewed. Question stems, choices, keys, and mapped-topic completeness outside this set were not changed. Guideline citation does not transfer all recommendations into the app. Legacy nursing sources have statements outside retained lesson scope that were not adopted.
